349208.title: Cohen–Perkins–Sarantis–Tetali conjecture for independent sets in linear hypergraphs
349208.literal_statement:

382513.title: Frankl's conjecture for even $n+t$ and $t$-intersecting $k$-Sperner families
382513.literal_statement:
Let $[n]=\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $\mathcal{F}\subseteq 2^{[n]}$. Suppose that $n+t$ is even and $n>t$. **Frankl's conjecture.** If $\mathcal{F}$ is a $t$-intersecting $k$-Sperner family, then

$$
|\mathcal{F}|\leq \sum_{i=0}^{k-1}\binom{n}{(n+t)/2+i}.
$$

The conjectured extremal construction consists of the $k$ consecutive layers beginning at level $(n+t)/2$. Frankl proved the conjecture in several ranges; the general common extension of Milner's and Frankl's theorems remains open.
